description.zh: 实例的备份文件ID。您可以调用[DescribeBackups](~~473823~~)进行查询。
description.en: The ID of the backup file. You can call the [DescribeBackups](~~473823~~) operation to query the IDs of backup files.

description.zh: 需要延长至指定时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC 时间），该时间点不能早于当前过期时间。
description.en: The point in time to which you want to extend the expiration time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The time cannot be earlier than the current expiration time.

title.zh: 延长手动备份数据的过期时间
